title: Tenant-sweep upgrade controller with shadow dry-run and automated rollback
creator: Maya Chen
description: Build an automated upgrade controller for VPC/private control planes that performs tenant-sweep canary promotions using Terraform plans and a shadow dry-run cluster. The controller should orchestrate staged Terraform applies, execute preflight compatibility checks (DB migrations, KV cache schema, CRD compatibility), mirror production traffic to a shadow control plane for validation, and implement an automated rollback when health/slo thresholds are violated. Goal: reduce manual runbook steps for upgrades, catch regressions earlier, and provide deterministic rollback behavior for Private deployments.
acceptance_criteria: Controller can generate cohort groups (tenant sweeps) based on tenancy weight, region, and workload tags
Terraform plan/apply flow can be executed in staged mode with manual approval gates and automated promotion triggers
Shadow dry-run cluster receives mirrored read traffic and synthetic probes; health scoring computed and surfaced in Console
Automated rollback triggers on composite health index breach (latency, error-rate, reconciliation-failures) and reverts Terraform state to previous known-good version
All control plane upgrade steps are logged and linkable to a single GitHub PR and Confluence runbook
Metrics and traces for canary cohorts visible in per-route dashboards and an upgrade-specific trace view
implementation_notes: Add a new Terraform module private/controlplane/upgrade that exposes plan/apply targets and supports staged targets (shadow, cohort-1..N, global)
Implement controller as service in controlplane-ops with an operator pattern: reconcile desired 'upgrade-session' CRD stored in S3/GCS alongside Terraform state
Shadow dry-run uses ephemeral VPC cluster that replays read-only traffic via traffic-mirroring; write paths use synthetic dry-run harness to validate DB migrations
Composite health index = weighted(99th-latency, error-rate, reconciliation-count, controlplane-api-5xx, KV-cache-evictions); thresholds configurable per-release
Rollback: run terraform apply with pinned previous version modules and run pod-level compatibility probes before re-introducing traffic
Integrate with existing rollout policy service for feature flags and tenant-exempt lists
test_plan: Unit tests for cohort generation logic and Terraform plan parsing
E2E in staging: create upgrade-session that performs shadow dry-run, then promote a small tenant cohort (5% of tenants) with monitored synthetic probes
Chaos tests: inject increased API error-rate in shadow cluster to validate automatic rollback
Dry-run DB migration in shadow using copy of schema and verify compatibilty checks catch backward-incompatible changes
Security review/stress test for Terraform state handling and S3/GCS encryption
rollout_plan: Phase 0: Feature branch + infra modules landed; internal staging runs for 2 full upgrade rehearsals
Phase 1: Open-source-lite demo cluster for internal SEs; gather early telemetry
Phase 2: First customer pilot – enable tenant-sweep for non-critical tenant group via manual approval
Phase 3: Automated promotions enabled with conservative thresholds and 1-hour observation windows
Phase 4: Gradually widen cohort sizes and reduce observation windows as confidence increases; document runbook for emergency rollback
